title: External Standards Adoption Framework and Evidence-Governance Architecture
purpose: Where a TMI vertical lacks proprietary research, verified outcomes, proprietary methodology, clinical evidence, legal authority, or owner-approved proof, its internal OPERATING standard defaults to a reviewed industry best-practice baseline. This never becomes a public claim without a separate owner decision and real operational readiness.

adoptionHierarchy.name: Proprietary TMI evidence
adoptionHierarchy.requirement: Owner-provided artifact + governance review (existing proof-registry pattern)
adoptionHierarchy.mustNot: be assumed, inferred, or backfilled from a general standard

adoptionHierarchy.name: Independently substantiated evidence
adoptionHierarchy.requirement: Third-party research/standards/guidance reviewed for relevance, date, authority, jurisdiction, limitations, applicability
adoptionHierarchy.mustNot: be presented as proprietary TMI evidence, research, or methodology

adoptionHierarchy.name: Industry best-practice baseline
adoptionHierarchy.requirement: Used internally only, specifically because Tier 1/2 evidence is absent
adoptionHierarchy.mustNot: imply certification, compliance, outcome assurance, or professional qualification

adoptionHierarchy.name: Owner decision and operational reality gate
adoptionHierarchy.requirement: Actual team, process, systems, policies, staffing, insurance, legal review, support capacity, privacy posture, AND evidence must all be in place, AND the owner must explicitly decide
adoptionHierarchy.mustNot: ever be skipped before any public promise
